name: @bananasplitapp/cli
description: Command-line access to the BananaSplit API

scripts.contract:download: bun -e "const url = process.env.BANANASPLIT_CONTRACT_URL; if (!url) throw new Error('Set BANANASPLIT_CONTRACT_URL (in .env or the shell)'); const res = await fetch(url); if (!res.ok) throw new Error(res.status + ' from ' + url); await Bun.write('server.d.ts', res);"
